review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.230 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -1.3 goals. It counts toward Hockey+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).
